opening.argument: The available material shows a woman speaking into a microphone on a decorated stage, while the title presents crypto-related terms, an online-earning phrase, and a contact number: “#forsage #crypto #cryptocurrency #earnmoneyonline Contact -7667280494.” That wording is promotional in tone, but it does not identify a specific guaranteed return, required payment, information request, or deceptive claim. It also does not explain what viewers would receive, what mechanism would apply, or where money or data would flow. The stage setting may accompany promotion, yet it does not establish a particular transaction or outcome. On this record, the material supports general promotional or entertainment-oriented content without the concrete elements needed to establish deceptive solicitation.
